description.value: Co-operative car share with hundreds of home locations across the Lower Mainland (Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Coquitlam and more), Victoria area (including Esquimalt, Oak Bay, Saanich, Sidney), Nanaimo, Squamish, and Kelowna. Also at major BC Ferries terminals. Open to non-BC residents — N licence or equivalent from any jurisdiction required. Some vehicles have exterior bike racks; SUVs and minivans available for carrying bikes inside.

Exterior rack.detail: Available on select vehicles — check vehicle listing when booking

Interior transport.detail: SUVs and minivans available for carrying bikes inside
